why: EQUIVALENT on the shipped tree, and the entry exists to say which fact makes it so. `canAct` is `phase === 'live'` while GRACE_TICKS is 0 (constants.ts), so today the two expressions are identical and no test can tell them apart -- this entry is the measurement that says so out loud instead of leaving the reader to wonder whether the choice was arbitrary. It stops being equivalent the moment grace is re-enabled, which that constant's own comment describes as a one-number change: grace is a phase in which tanks move and hunt but may not fire, and the rule this implements is 'start at LIVE acquisition', not 'start when firing is allowed'. A test that killed this today would have to fabricate a positive GRACE_TICKS, which pins a phase the game does not currently ship.
